compiled_state.title: No structural test asserting recipe: dispatch row exists in sprint SKILL.md Phase E
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
The recipe: TESTING_MODE routing row added to sprint SKILL.md Phase E has no structural test asserting its presence. Other dispatch rows have tests in tests/hooks/ that grep for their routing logic. If this section is accidentally removed, the sprint orchestrator would silently fall through to incorrect behavior.

## Why
Identified in code review cycle 4 of task 96ab-abd1 (UPDATE: Add recipe: task routing to sprint Phase E dispatch). Not fixable inline during an instruction-file UPDATE task.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add a test in tests/hooks/ or tests/skills/ that asserts the recipe: row exists in SKILL.md Phase E dispatch table
- Test file registered in .test-index

comments.body:
fix-bug:investigation

VERDICT: LIVE — no test asserting the recipe: dispatch row exists. Confirmed via exhaustive grep across tests/skills/, tests/hooks/, and git log since ticket creation.

STALE CHECK: Searched all test files for 'recipe' + 'sprint' combinations. Only hits are tests for recipe-adjacent scripts (check-recipe-engines.sh, detect-cleanup-recipes.sh, format-recipe-result.sh, translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh) — none assert the recipe: dispatch row in sprint SKILL.md Phase E.

DISPATCH ROW LOCATION:
- File: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md line 1657
- Row content: | recipe: | Execute via recipe-executor.sh directly — no sub-agent dispatch. See **recipe: execution flow** below. |
- Within the TESTING_MODE routing table (lines 1652-1658), under Phase E: Sub-Agent Launch

EXACT TEST FILE TO CREATE:
- Path: tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-recipe-dispatch.sh
- Follows pattern of tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-mode-banner.sh and tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh
- Must be registered in .test-index under plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md entry

WHAT THE TEST ASSERTS (3 structural markers from lines 1652-1704):
1. The recipe: dispatch row is present in the TESTING_MODE routing table — grep for 'recipe:' followed by 'recipe-executor.sh' on the same table row (line 1657)
2. The 'recipe: execution flow' section header is present (line 1664) — confirms the referenced flow section exists
3. recipe: tasks do NOT create a story branch (line 1704) — asserts the no-sub-agent-dispatch behavioral invariant is documented
4. recipe-executor.sh reference is present in the execution flow (line 1685) — confirms the actual execution command is documented

RED CONFIRMATION: If the recipe: row (line 1657) is removed from SKILL.md, test 1 fails. If the execution flow section is removed, tests 2-4 fail. The test will pass on current code and fail if the row is deleted — true RED/GREEN behavior.

SPRINT-EDIT: NO — test-only. Does NOT modify sprint/SKILL.md. Safe alongside sibling bug 2b01.

FIX APPROACH:
1. Create tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-recipe-dispatch.sh (chmod +x)
2. Source tests/lib/assert.sh, load SKILL.md content
3. Assert 4 structural markers listed above using assert_contains
4. Add to .test-index on the plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md line

BEHAVIORAL TESTING STANDARD COMPLIANCE: Rule 5 permits structural presence tests for instruction-file dispatch rows where LLM behavior is non-executable. Pattern matches existing tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-mode-banner.sh which uses assert_contains on SKILL.md content.
